h1: Custom Canvas Cables & Cords for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Canvas Cables & Cords | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom canvas cables and cords for your brand. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Canvas cables and cords offer a rugged, textured look that stands out from standard plastic or nylon options. The natural fabric feels substantial in hand and wears well over time, making it ideal for lanyards, badge holders, or keychains used daily by employees or event attendees. Choose screen printing or debossing to add your logo, and pick from multiple widths and lengths to match your specific needs.
heroAltText: Custom canvas cables and cords with printed logos, displayed on a neutral background
